theta_e.method: arc radius from the deflector centre

system.description: The green arrow marks the deflector at the centre of the cutout. The cyan arrow points to a faint blue arc segment on its eastern side, curving around the deflector at about 1.8"; the magenta arrow marks a diffuse candidate counter-image to the west that needs deeper data. Dashed circles mark field galaxies and dotted circles stars to mask.

items.label: arc segment (E)
items.rationale: blue arc east of the deflector

items.label: diffuse cand.
items.rationale: faint diffuse source opposite the arc
